changes.summary: CI test Postgres no longer logs every statement, so service teardown stops pushing the Unit & Integration job past its timeout.

styles/tailwind/iota.css declares the `dark` variant as the theme class on <html>, so hosts that build it over a Tailwind config without darkMode no longer compile `dark:` under prefers-color-scheme (BiChat sidebar and other dark: utilities followed the OS instead of the chosen light theme).
Release publishing waits up to 10 minutes for npm to expose a new SDK version before failing with npm_visibility_timeout.

Solid UI: Metrics KPI band, MetricsSkeleton and KpiTile/KpiTiles dashboard tiles on the shared .iota-mx-* styles, with BigInt-exact formatAmount, formatCompact, order and sign helpers; dark-mode contrast for the band links.
